summary: Iteration 6: Full backend + frontend regression on GitHub widgets, LiveInfo card, Section Visibility toggles, and LiveInfo Manager new controls. All 4 bugs verified as fixed. Backend 3/3 pytest passed; frontend all 4 bug scenarios + regression tabs passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1378 lines - consider splitting into feature modules (widgets/auth/analytics/theme) in a future refactor.
PUT /api/admin/widgets accepts arbitrary dict without Pydantic validation; malformed payloads could pollute the widgets doc.
seed_data_creation: None (all values restored to defaults after tests: GitHub visible, LiveInfo visible, show_on_mobile=false, dismissible=true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug #1: GitHub stats card renders 5 tiles with real numbers (5 repos, 3 followers, etc). Top Languages shows Python 100%. Calendar rects use GitHub greens [#9be9a8,#40c463,#30a14e,#216e39] with #ebedf0 empty cells; Less/More legend and 'contributions' text present. Bug #3: visibility-widgets-grid + visibility-widget-github and visibility-widget-live_info toggles work — turning off hides sections on / and restoring shows them again. Bug #4: All LiveInfo Manager controls (enabled, position L/R, pulse, mobile, dismissible, intervals 10/15/30/60, online/visitors/views/updated, save) present. show_on_mobile=true makes card visible at 390x844; dismissible=false hides the close button. Backend GET /api/widgets returns both github and live_info sub-docs; PUT persists new keys show_on_mobile and dismissible.
rca of the issue: N/A - all reported bugs verified fixed by main agent's implementation.
